Strategy: Last-bin preference: add a large bonus to the newest feasible bin and score the rest by tightest fit, so items stack into the most recently opened bin, keeping older bins untouched for items that fit only them. It can fail when the newest bin is a poor fit and the bonus overrides much tighter alternatives.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    f = bins[len(bins) - 1]
    return [(-(r - item) + (500.0 if r == f else 0.0)) for r in bins]
```
